name: county-migration
what_it_holds: IRS SOI county-to-county migration lookup tool for the 2010-2011 tax year (most recent year IRS published this format at county level): inflow/outflow counts, net migration, top origin/destination counties, and average AGI per flow, US counties.
why_useful: Adds average-AGI-by-migration-flow, a rough proxy for the income level of movers into second-home/vacation destination counties -- useful for wealth-segment demand context, though only a single-year snapshot.
themes: Population, migration and second-home data (IRS migration, Census CPS, USPS change of address, second-home counts, holiday-home shares Europe)
why_all: Adds average-AGI-by-migration-flow, a rough proxy for the income level of movers into second-home/vacation destination counties -- useful for wealth-segment demand context, though only a single-year snapshot.
